info.action_syntax_body:
Actions can be chained with commas `,`, up to 5. Available actions:
`delete` / `delete_dm` — delete the message (optionally with a warning)
`warn` / `warn_dm` — send a warning message
`mute <duration>` — time out the user
`kick` — kick the user
`ban <duration> <message deletion window>` — ban the user
`send_mod_message` — send a moderation notice
`force_verify <duration>` — force web verification (web verification must be enabled first)
Use {builder} to generate an action string, or {check} to preview it.
info.desc:
AutoModerate provides several automated protections to help admins keep order in the server.
Use {quick_setup} for the interactive quick setup (recommended), {setup} to configure all options for one feature at once, {toggle} to enable or disable a feature, {settings} to tweak individual parameters, and {view} to see the current configuration.

feature_body.anti_invite_link:
Detects Discord invite links; you can choose whether to allow invites to this server.
Settings: `allow_current_server`, `action`, `ignore_channels`
feature_body.anti_raid:
Detects a burst of users joining, then actions everyone who joined in the window.
Settings: `max_joins` (default 5), `time_window` (seconds, default 60), `action`
feature_body.anti_spam:
Detects a user sending identical or highly similar messages in a short window.
Settings: `max_messages` (default 5), `time_window` (seconds, default 30), `similarity` (threshold 0-100, default 75), `action`, `ignore_channels`
feature_body.anti_uispam:
Detects how often a user triggers commands via User Install, to prevent abuse.
Settings: `max_count` (default 5), `time_window` (seconds, default 60), `action`, `ignore_channels`
feature_body.automod_detect:
When a native Discord AutoMod rule fires, send a notice to a channel and optionally run an extra action.
Settings: `log_channel`, `action` (optional)
Filters: `filter_rule` (rule-name filter, `|`-separated for multiple), `filter_action_type` (action-type filter: block/alert/timeout/block_interactions, `|`-separated)
feature_body.escape_punish:
When a user leaves the server while timed out, run an extra punishment (e.g. a ban) automatically.
Settings: `punishment`, `duration`
feature_body.flagged_user:
Merges local flag records from the last three months with the Blacklist API cache; notifies on join and can run an action.
Settings: `log_channel`, `action` (optional), `action_source` (local/api/both), `local_match_mode` (active/history)
feature_body.scamtrap:
Set up a honeypot channel; anyone who posts there is actioned automatically.
Settings: `channel_id` (channel), `action` (action to take)
feature_body.too_many_emojis:
Counts emoji in a message (custom and Unicode) and actions the author above the limit.
Settings: `max_emojis` (default 10), `action`, `ignore_channels`
feature_body.too_many_h1:
Detects when the total length of Markdown headings (`# `) in a message is excessive, to prevent spam.
Settings: `max_length` (default 20), `action`, `ignore_channels`
